mentions.name: JSONL Viewer Pro
mentions.description: A desktop app built with C++ and ImGui for viewing JSONL files, with recent support for reading uncompressed parquet files; the next step is integrating a visual data pipeline using ImNodes, targeting both macOS and Windows.
mentions.source_excerpt:
My first app is a JSONL Viewer. Recently I‘ve added support to read parquet files (uncompressed) too.

https://iotdata.systems/jsonlviewerpro/
